title: Basis on which a Marketplace Valuation of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing Is Worked Out
content:
A marketplace valuation of a Keyturn Vehicle Listing starts from the vehicle value standing on the listing and steps that value down for the time that has passed since the valuation standing on the vehicle's condition record.

The standard step-down is six thousandths (0.006) of the starting value for each whole calendar month counted from the anchor date to the handling date, a part month not counting, and the anchor date is the date of the valuation standing on the condition record. The step-down is worked out as one rate for the whole stretch of months and taken off the starting value once, and is never compounded month by month. The stepped figure is rounded half away from zero to two decimal places, and that rounded figure is the valuation the marketplace records.

Where the vehicle's record calls for holdbacks, they are summed into a single rate, that rate is applied once to the stepped figure, and the figure so reduced is rounded half away from zero to two decimal places and recorded in place of the stepped figure.

### Worked through on hypothetical records

*Starting value 20000.00 USD, anchor date 10 whole calendar months and 12 days before the handling date, no holdback called for.* The part month does not count, so the stretch is 10 whole months. Six thousandths taken over 10 months is sixty thousandths for the whole stretch, and sixty thousandths of 20000.00 USD is 1200.00 USD. The starting value less that step-down is 18800.00 USD, which rounded half away from zero to two decimal places is 18800.00 USD, and that is the valuation recorded.

*The same vehicle where the record calls for holdbacks of two and a half hundredths and one and a half hundredths.* The two are summed into a single rate of four hundredths, which applied once to the stepped figure of 18800.00 USD takes off 752.00 USD; the figure so reduced is 18048.00 USD, and that is what is recorded in place of the stepped figure.

*Why the step-down is not compounded.* Over the same 10 months a rate laid on afresh each month would leave 18832.35 USD rather than 18800.00 USD. The valuation is worked out as one rate for the whole stretch, so 18800.00 USD is the stepped figure.
